proposals.title: Detached auxiliary heads contribute AST proposal credit only
proposals.mechanism: Purchase-only trunk/head; view/cart readouts trained on detached hidden state. Eight paid gate-gradient checkpoints produce bounded positive-cosine auxiliary program credit. Freeze one top-three whole bundle per selector, then fresh purchase-only B41 quality contrast.
proposals.testable_prediction: With identical purchase proxy trajectory/pool/bundle size, auxiliary-credit bundle improves newly reserved purchase fullY query-macro NDCG20 versus purchase-credit-only bundle; no improvement asserted.
proposals.nearest_source_free_experiment: Own two-row analytic gate-gradient/credit reversal and three-logit BCE/NDCG counterexample; future reviewed stop-gradient invariance fixture before any fit. No source-free utility proof.
proposals.benefit_task1: Potentially improve automatic strict-past feature allocation for purchase-only boosting without auxiliary updates to deployed representation or altered purchase target.
proposals.nearest_existing_experiment: HYP065 changes shared encoder through purchase+any loss; this changes program-selection consumer while primary proxy trajectory stays purchase-only. Existing learned search/proxy/gradient balancing foundation reused.
proposals.novelty_boundary: Not a new auxiliary head/loss/encoder/teacher family. Coordinator must merge if fixed existing search already has detached auxiliary-only proposal credit; zero new HYP assignment.
proposals.simple_control: One fully charged common three-head proxy; purchase selector consumes cP only, auxiliary selector cA. Three downstream fresh B41 arms baseline/Pbundle/Abundle under common later timeline. Standalone P selector is cheaper and logical work reported separately.
proposals.counterhypothesis: Dense behaviors reward activity/popularity/redundancy; primary-trained representation cannot expose useful auxiliary distinctions; gradient credit does not measure conditional feature utility.
